functions.notes: Target loads limit (f88/c0) then timer and does cmp timer,limit; bhs. Source 'limit > timer' gives right load order but cmp limit,timer; bls. Source 'timer < limit' gives cmp timer,limit; bhs but loads timer first (regs swapped). Tried unsigned types, locals, negations, flattened && , comma-assign, colorsweep --apply (no change).
